lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in semi-regular vertical columns. The spatial distribution shows higher clustering in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity correspond with the gill slit structures and subsequent skin folds, intersecting with the horizontal rows of white spots to form a matrix-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is detectable in the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic light patterns from surface water refraction create a secondary high-intensity web-like overlay across the dorsal and posterior-lateral sections of the animal.
